day_shape: Khamenei buried in Mashhad after multi-day funeral processions, US-Iran strikes continue with reported bridge hit and Hormuz shipping disruption, IDF says campaign in Iran 'not over' and demolishes Hezbollah tunnels in southern Lebanon.

threads.label: Khamenei burial and funeral messaging
threads.summary: Ali Khamenei was buried at the Imam Reza shrine in Mashhad on Friday evening after days of processions in Iran and Iraq, with successor Mojtaba Khamenei absent from public ceremonies. Regime channels flooded output with tributes from IRGC commander Rezaei, army chief Hatami and Larijani, and Khamenei's office called the martyred leader a 'wise jurist and tireless mujahid'.

threads.label: US-Iran strikes and Hormuz shipping
threads.summary: Iran International reported two days of US strikes on Iran's southern coast and Iranian attacks on Persian Gulf shipping, with Tehran suspending Tehran-Mashhad rail service after a reported US strike on a railway bridge. CENTCOM said US forces have facilitated transit of 800+ commercial vessels and 380 million barrels through Hormuz since May, while Tanker Trackers reported Iran shipped out 10 million barrels overnight.

threads.label: Diplomatic channel and Trump plot report
threads.summary: A senior US official told CNN 'diplomacy is continuing' despite intermittent strikes in Iran, while the Jerusalem Post reported Israel shared new intelligence with Washington on an alleged Iranian plot to assassinate President Trump. US Ambassador Huckabee said things 'won't go well' for Iran if it continues escalating.

threads.label: Israeli readiness for renewed Iran campaign
threads.summary: At a pilots' graduation ceremony, IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir said the Iran campaign is 'not over' with major operations expected, and Defence Minister Katz said the IDF is prepared to resume strikes 'even for a third time'. Netanyahu said Iran will not have a nuclear weapon 'either with or without a deal'.

threads.label: IDF operations in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said it dismantled two Hezbollah tunnel routes totalling around 200 metres in Majdal Zoun containing three launch shafts and dozens of weapons, and located additional weapons facilities in the security zone. A US official said the first 'pilot zone' handing an area back to the Lebanese army will launch 'in a matter of days', while Trump and Katz gave conflicting statements on Israeli withdrawal.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and tunnel demolitions
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed PIJ weapons-production commander Rashid al-Qadhi in a southern Gaza strike, and killed Waheed Abu Salam, a former Khan Yunis company commander who took part in the October 7 attack. The military also said it demolished five Hamas tunnels spanning around two kilometres in northern Gaza on the Israeli side of the ceasefire line.

threads.label: Iran domestic pressures and January dead
threads.summary: Iran International reported renewed power and water outages during summer heat despite official assurances the grid is stable, and described media split between calls for retaliation and warnings of civilian cost. The Jerusalem Post published profiles of Iranians killed in January protests including Sina Kazemi, Ali Mohammadi and Mohammad Jamalian.

events.title: Two more Hezbollah tunnels in the southern Lebanon town of Majdal Zoun were recently demolished, the IDF announces. The tunnels spanned a total of some 200 meters, and reached depths of around 20 meters underground, according to the military. Inside the tunnels, troops found several rooms where operatives would reside, three launch shafts, and dozens of weapons, the IDF says. These tunnels are in addition to a major underground drone facility that the IDF uncovered and demolished last month.
